messages:
elaine: Heads-up — dropping a draft RFC/PRD for scoped API keys + role mapping. Need engineering + security signoff before we ship to Dedicated/Private customers.

raj: thanks. is this a customer-driven ask or internal platform gap?

elaine: a bit of both. two customers asked for project-scoped keys, and we want to support least-privilege for internal automation too.

marta: can you call out the primary flows? user-created key, service key for infra, and short-lived delegations?

elaine: yep. primary flows in doc: 1) org admin creates project-scoped key tied to project id + role, 2) service creates ephemeral token via mint endpoint, 3) cross-org integration via allowed external principals.

samir: important: acceptance criteria must include audit events + KMS key provenance. also need behaviour on revoked keys (immediate vs graceful).

elaine: noted — I added audit + revocation semantics. current proposal: revoke => immediate deny, plus 24h cache TTL for tokens with forced revalidation for sensitive ops.

olivia: how will this change SDK UX? we should avoid forcing users to store raw project ids in envs. maybe alias tokens with names.

marta: SDK: fetch metadata from /v1/keys/:id -> {scopes, roles, project} and crate helpers: KeyClient.createScopedKey(project, roles). Keep sync/async parity.

raj: launch criteria? which modes need to be supported day-1? Hosted + Dedicated. Private can be beta with config flags.

elaine: agreed. day-1: hosted API (token minting, key lifecycle, RBAC enforcement). Dedicated: same API + local KMS integration. Private: doc-only and opt-in.

samir: edge-case: keys created before feature rollout — legacy keys should map to org-level admin role, not bearer-all. we need migration policy.

elaine: plan: existing keys get an implicit role "org:legacy-admin" with scoped enforcement; opt-in migration tool for customers. document will include SQL for migration.

marta: performance: auth checks in hot path — we should cache policy decisions in memcache with short TTL and support cache-bypass header for debugging.

olivia: add CLI and SDK commands to rotate keys and to list key metadata (no secrets returned). UX acceptance: minimal friction for infra.

elaine: acceptance checklist (short):
- API endpoints: POST /v1/keys, GET /v1/keys/:id, POST /v1/tokens/mint, POST /v1/keys/:id/revoke
- Token format: JWT with `scp`, `proj`, `role`, `exp` claims (no raw api_secret in token)
- Audit events for create/mint/revoke with actor, ip, reason
- RBAC enforcement for all generation & runtime endpoints
- Backwards compatibility migration plan
- SDK + CLI helpers + docs
- E2E test harness + perf budget (P99 auth latency < 3ms cached, < 20ms cold)

raj: where's the doc? share link pls.

elaine: pastebin: https://internal.docs/rfcs/1772154123-scoped-api-key-role-mapping (draft)

marta: quick comments inline: 
- require `proj` claim for project-scoped tokens
- deny list for project ids (sensitive projects)

samir: security comments:
- require strong KMS wrapping for stored secrets
- require rotation policy in enterprise contracts
- limit mint endpoint to 1 req/sec per key by default

olivia: add rollout plan: staged: opt-in tenants -> canary -> 100% hosted -> Dedicated -> Private. include telemetry to track rejected requests and migration completions.

elaine: updated doc with those items. can folks +1 the draft or leave comments by EOD?

raj: +1 from product side, focus on clear migration UX.

marta: +1 but need a follow-up PRD for SDK changes with acceptance tests.

samir: +1 pending KMS integration tests and audit logging proofs.

olivia: +1. I'll add CLI wireframes.

spec-bot: RFC draft posted and assigned to: marta, samir, olivia. Review due in 48h.

elaine: thanks — I'll iterate and post v2 with the example payloads and sample SQL migration.

raj: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow to triage conflicts and finalize launch checklist.
